### Data Analysis
We will use data from the [NHANES](https://wwwn.cdc.gov/nchs/nhanes/) (1999–2003) to describe the health status of the U.S. population (ages 30-85).
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .feature-card}
### The Dataset
The data is stored in `nhanes30.sav`. This file contains observed data, variable descriptions, and metadata.
:::
:::

### Variable description

<!-- Value codes checked against nhanes30.sav. MORTSTAT has no embedded labels; coding follows https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/data/datalinkage/public-use-linked-mortality-file-description.Pdf. BMI upper boundaries checked against observed bmi/bmi_cat pairs. -->

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import itables
from itables import JavascriptFunction
import itables.options as opt
opt.warn_on_undocumented_option = False
itables.options.columnDefs = [
    {"className": "dt-left variable-column", "targets": 0, "width": "18%"},
    {"className": "dt-left description-column", "targets": 1, "width": "46%"},
    {
        "className": "dt-left values-column", "targets": 2, "width": "36%",
        "render": JavascriptFunction(r"""function(data, type) {
            if (type !== "display") return data;
            if (!data) return '<span class="value-empty">—</span>';
            const escape = text => String(text).replace(/[&<>"']/g, char => ({
                '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
            }[char]));
            const readable = text => escape(text.replace(/([<>≥≤])\s*/g, '$1 ')
                .replace(/([MmFf]):/g, '$1: '));
            if (!/^\d+=/.test(data)) return readable(data);
            const items = data.split(/[,;]\s*(?=\d+=)/).map(item => {
                const separator = item.indexOf('=');
                return '<li><span class="value-code">' + escape(item.slice(0, separator))
                    + '</span><span>' + readable(item.slice(separator + 1)) + '</span></li>';
            });
            return '<ul class="value-list">' + items.join('') + '</ul>';
        }""")
    }
]

data_dict = pd.DataFrame({
    "Variable name": [
        "SEQN", "nteeth", "cal_mean", "perio", "perio2", "bop", "sex", "age",
        "edu", "smk", "smk2", "alcg", "height", "weight", "bmi", "bmi_cat",
        "wc", "wc_cat", "diab", "mortstat", "permth_exm"
    ],
    "Description": [
        "Participant ID",
        "Number of natural teeth",
        "Mean clinical attachment loss",
        "Periodontitis (CDC–AAP definition, Eke et al. 2012)",
        "Periodontitis",
        "Bleeding on probing (World Definition, Tonetti et al. 2018)",
        "Sex",
        "Age",
        "Education level",
        "Smoking status",
        "Smoking status (collapsed)",
        "Alcohol consumption",
        "Height",
        "Weight",
        "Body Mass Index",
        "BMI categories",
        "Waist circumference",
        "Waist circumference categories",
        "Diabetes",
        "Mortality status",
        "Number of person-months between examination and death/censoring"
    ],
    "Values": [
        "",                  # SEQN
        "0–32",              # nteeth
        "mm",                # cal_mean
        "1=None, 2=Mild, 3=Moderate, 4=Severe",  # perio
        "1=Yes, 2=No",       # perio2
        "1=None, 2=<10%, 3=≥10%",  # bop
        "1=Female, 2=Male",  # sex
        "Years",             # age
        "1=<9th grade/missing, 2=9–11 grade/high school, 3=≥some college",  # edu
        "1=Never, 2=Former, 3=Current",  # smk
        "1=Never, 2=Former/Current",     # smk2
        "Grams per day",     # alcg
        "cm",                # height
        "kg",                # weight
        "kg/m²",             # bmi
        "1=<18.5, 2=18.5–<25, 3=25–<30, 4=≥30",  # bmi_cat
        "cm",                # wc
        "1=M:<102,F:<88; 2=M:≥102,F:≥88",     # wc_cat
        "1=Yes, 2=No",       # diab
        "0=Assumed alive, 1=Assumed deceased",  # mortstat: CDC linked mortality coding
        ""                   # permth_exm
    ]
})

# Show the table

itables.show(
    data_dict,
    # The display renderer escapes labels; avoid escaping comparison signs twice.
    allow_html=True,
    dom="Brtip",
    classes="display stripe hover course-data-table",
    style="table-layout:fixed;width:100%",
    columnControl=["order", ["orderAsc", "orderDesc", "search"]],
    ordering={"indicators": False, "handler": False},
    buttons=["columnsToggle", {"extend": "csv", "text": "Download data description", "exportOptions": {"orthogonal": "export"}}],
    paging=False,       # no pagination
   # scrollY=None,       # disable scrolling limit
    scrollCollapse=False
)

```

:::{.hidden}
| **Variable name** | **Description** | **Values** |
|:------------------|:--------------|:-----------------|
| SEQN | Participant ID |  |
| nteeth | Number of natural teeth | 0–32 |
| cal_mean | Mean clinical attachment loss | mm |
| perio | Periodontitis (CDC–AAP definition, Eke et al. 2012) | 1=None, 2=Mild, 3=Moderate, 4=Severe |
| perio2 | Periodontitis | 1=Yes, 2=No |
| bop | Bleeding on probing (World Definition, Tonetti et al. 2018) | 1=None, 2=<10%, 3= $\geq$ 10% |
| sex | Sex | 1=Female, 2=Male |
| age | Age | Years |
| edu | Education level | 1=<9th grade/missing, 2=9–11 grade/high school, 3=$\geq$ some college |
| smk | Smoking status | 1=Never, 2=Former, 3=Current |
| smk2 | Smoking status | 1=Never, 2=Former/Current |
| alcg | Alcohol consumption | Grams per day |
| height | Height | cm |
| weight | Weight | kg |
| bmi | Body Mass Index | kg/m² |
| bmi_cat | BMI categories | 1= $<$ 18.5, 2=18.5–<25, 3=25–<30, 4= $\geq$ 30 |
| wc | Waist circumference | cm |
| wc_cat | Waist circumference categories | 1=M: $<$ 102, F: $<$ 88; 2=M: $\geq$ 102, F: $\geq$ 88 |
| diab | Diabetes | 1=Yes, 2=No |
| mortstat | Mortality status | 0=Assumed alive, 1=Assumed deceased |
| permth_exm | Number of person-months between examination and death/censoring |  |
:::
